name: Crovax
description: Crovax is an aristocratic human nobleman of Urborg who joined the Weatherlight crew, became a vampire after killing the angel Selenia, and then became the Phyrexian Evincar of Rath.

description_citations.text: Weatherlight: card flavor text (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Crovax is an aristocratic human nobleman of Urborg who joined the Weatherlight crew, became a vampire after killing the angel Selenia, and then became the Phyrexian Evincar of Rath.

citations.text: Weatherlight: card flavor text (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Crovax left Urborg with the artifact binding Selenia to join the Weatherlight crew, and Phyrexian agents slaughtered his family.

citations.text: "Crovax", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Crovax", section "Serving aboard Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He shattered the artifact and Selenia flew away, leaving him cursed to destroy all that he loved.

citations.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Rath he struck down Selenia in the Dream Halls, and her shards warped him into a vampire.

citations.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He killed Mirri after she followed him onto the deck and they fell into Volrath's garden.

citations.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Taken to Phyrexia, Kirril compleated him and groomed him as evincar of Rath.

citations.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He defeated Greven, impaled 6,000 hostages on flowstone spikes after the failed Skyshroud assault, forced Belbe to name him evincar and defeated Volrath in a duel with Ertai's help.

citations.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After the Rathi Overlay he oversaw Phyrexian domination of Urborg, executed Tsabo Tavoc, and tried to convince Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.

citations.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Gerrard sliced Crovax in half in the Stronghold throne room.

citations.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Crovax is dead, killed by Gerrard in the Stronghold, and Selenia recovered his normal soul.

citations.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion (4205 AR to 4206 AR) [ 16 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax joins the Weatherlight crew to rescue their abducted captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: joining the crew of the *Weatherlight* as they seek to rescue their abducted captain Sisay.

citation.text: Crovax (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax freed Selenia from her magical bindings; she chose to leave him.
timeline.quote: Selenia was freed from her magical bindings by the wealthy noble.

citation.text: Selenia (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax recounts his family being killed and ancestors fed on.
timeline.quote: "They killed my family to deny me a future. They fed on my ancestors to deny me a past."

citation.text: Barrow Ghoul (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax accepts a place aboard the Weatherlight, leaving his rotting family.
timeline.quote: "You must be mad to want one such as I aboard the *Weatherlight*. But I would be mad to remain here with my rotting family. I accept."

citation.text: Shattered Crypt (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax says he was damned to solitude after refusing to barter his soul.
timeline.quote: So they took it from me and damned me to solitude."

citation.text: Infernal Tribute (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians attack Crovax's Estate hunting Bloodline subjects; Rofellos is killed and Gerrard quits the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: During this battle, Rofellos was killed, which was too much for Gerrard.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri dives in front of Crovax to deflect Selenia's strike and is gravely wounded; Crovax slays Selenia and Tahngarth carries both back to the ship.
timeline.quote: Mirri dove in front of him to deflect one of Selenia's strikes.

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri sees Crovax sabotaging the Weatherlight's sails, attacks him, and both tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden.
timeline.quote: She attacked Crovax, causing both of them to tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden .

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri lets Crovax kill her so that Gerrard will save himself, fulfilling the spirit beast's prophecy.
timeline.quote: Mirri let Crovax kill her so that Gerrard would save himself.

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax sees a banquet in the dead.
timeline.quote: for one dark moment he saw a banquet.

citation.text: Dregs of Sorrow (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath vows to bind Crovax with pain.
timeline.quote: I have made Crovax weep; now I will make him scream.

citation.text: Endless Scream (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax watches Selenia lead the Predator to the Weatherlight and feels betrayed.
timeline.quote: Crovax had witnessed Selenia lead the *Predator* to the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Enfeeblement (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax leaves Urborg to join the Weatherlight crew, taking the artifact binding Selenia.
timeline.quote: He took with him the artifact controlling Selenia so that he could be with her.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian agents Morinfen and Gallowbraid slaughter Crovax's family; Rofellos dies and Selenia defeats the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Rofellos became the first casualty of the battle.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Serving aboard Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eladamri outflanks Crovax's expeditionary force, but a failed rescue lets many survive, including Crovax.
timeline.quote: This meant that more of the Expeditionary Force survived, including Crovax.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Selenia, which triggers a curse that turns him into a vampire.
timeline.quote: Crovax killed her, but this triggered a curse on him and turned him into a vampire .

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath has vanished and the Stronghold falls into chaos; Greven takes charge and meets candidate Crovax and emissary Belbe.
timeline.quote: the evincar had disappeared, throwing the rest of the Stronghold into chaos.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven and Crovax fight and Crovax uses the mimetic spine to lay Greven low.
timeline.quote: Crovax had worked out how to control Greven

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax returns to the Stronghold and slaughters all the hostages.
timeline.quote: Crovax had survived and had teleported back to the Stronghold, where he had discovered the hostages and slaughtered every last one of them.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greven interrupts Crovax's coronation, Volrath resumes his true form, and Crovax defeats him in a duel after Ertai interferes.
timeline.quote: Ertai interfered by magically off-balancing Volrath, allowing Crovax to triumph.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Predator intercepts Weatherlight at Urborg; Greven's mind is dominated by Crovax and Tahngarth kills him.
timeline.quote: Greven soon fell beneath the raging minotaur

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selenia freezes and Crovax's blade kills her, fulfilling the curse.
timeline.quote: Crovax's blade found home.

citation.text: Death Stroke (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard tells Crovax he will tire before his pain does.
timeline.quote: you will tire before it does.

citation.text: Megrim (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax's rage reduces the shapeshifter to blood and shreds of flesh.
timeline.quote: Crovax's rage was horrifying.

citation.text: Amok (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax shatters the artifact binding Selenia, who flies away, and he is cursed to destroy all that he loves.
timeline.quote: He was now destined to destroy all that he loved.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Crovax sees Selenia leading an attack against the Weatherlight and breaks down.
timeline.quote: Embittered by his love's betrayal, Crovax became obsessed with getting revenge.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax tears apart a shapeshifter in Selenia's guise inside the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: In a fit of rage, he pursued it and tore it apart, much to the shock of his allies.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax strikes down Selenia, who shatters into shards that warp him into a vampire.
timeline.quote: Crovax's curse had been fulfilled: he had killed the love of his life and had been damned because of it.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Mirri after she follows him on deck and they fall into Volrath's garden.
timeline.quote: where Crovax then proceeded to kill the cat warrior.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril compleats him into a Phyrexian and he is groomed as evincar of Rath.
timeline.quote: he was to become the new evincar of Rath, needing only to prove himself to his masters before he could take the throne.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax defeats Greven, fails against the Skyshroud rebels, and impales 6,000 hostages on flowstone spikes.
timeline.quote: Crovax impaled the hostages on flowstone spikes.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax forces Belbe by coup to name him evincar, then defeats Volrath in a duel thanks to Ertai.
timeline.quote: With his victory over Volrath, Crovax's Coronation was a fact and his reign as evincar began.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ertai secretly helps Crovax win the duel against Volrath.
timeline.quote: he used his magic to off-balance Volrath at a critical moment and thus give Crovax the victory

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eladamri kills Belbe and flees to Dominaria, leaving Ertai to submit to Crovax.
timeline.quote: Belbe was killed by Eladamri

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selenia hurt Mirri badly and tore wounds in Crovax's soul that will not close.
timeline.quote: Selenia had hurt Mirri terribly

citation.text: Convalescence (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri follows Crovax's skulking form despite exhaustion.
timeline.quote: she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

citation.text: Curiosity (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A change comes over Crovax, whose bloodlust threatens the ship.
timeline.quote: His newly-formed bloodlust and thirst for power threaten to destroy the entire ship.

citation.text: "Exodus", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gallowbraid slays Rofellos and Crovax summons Selenia.
timeline.quote: When Rofellos was slain by Gallowbraid, Crovax used his cursed heirloom to summon the guardian angel Selenia

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The rescue party frees Karn and Tahngarth but finds only a shapeshifter in place of Sisay.
timeline.quote: It turned out to be a shapeshifter, however

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selenia wounds Mirri on the bridge to the Dream Halls.
timeline.quote: The angel turns her attack toward the cat warrior, slicing her deep across the belly.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax runs Selenia through with his sword.
timeline.quote: Crovax runs her through with his sword

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selenia's shards stream into Crovax and Tahngarth saves him from jumping.
timeline.quote: Selenia shatters into countless shards that stream into Crovax's body through his face.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax is transformed by his angel's death.
timeline.quote: having been transformed by his guardian angel's death

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth returns mutilated, carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth reappears, emerging from the Stronghold mutilated by Volrath's tortures and carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax ambushes Mirri in the lower deck of the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Mirri is ambushed from behind somewhere in the lower deck by her former ally, who says it is his destiny for him to kill her.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Mirri's Tale" ( Liz Holliday )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri takes Crovax overboard with her into the Gardens.
timeline.quote: she is dropped overboard by Crovax, but grabs his wrist and takes him down with her

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Mirri's Tale" ( Liz Holliday )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax bites Mirri's neck.
timeline.quote: He wrests free and tells her that she will join him to rule Rath, before biting into her neck.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Mirri's Tale" ( Liz Holliday )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leaves Mirri behind to die.
timeline.quote: departs with the ship, leaving the cat warrior behind to die

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Mirri's Tale" ( Liz Holliday )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax says he is confined by sleep and defined by nightmare.
timeline.quote: I am confined by sleep and defined by nightmare.

citation.text: Recurring Nightmare (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax says he followed a song only to find a dirge.
timeline.quote: I followed her song only to find it was a dirge.

citation.text: Whispers of the Muse (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Mirri after going insane and leaving the ship.
timeline.quote: Mirri had followed him, which had led to her death at his hands.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath returns to find his throne contested by Greven, Ertai and Crovax, and duels Crovax; Ertai's intervention lets Crovax win.
timeline.quote: Ertai had intervened on Crovax's behalf, off-balancing Volrath and allowing his opponent to secure his victory.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Crovax's coronation Vuel, stripped of his Phyrexian implants, is executed with flowstone manipulated by Ertai.
timeline.quote: Vuel was injected with a vial of liquid flowstone

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax announces that things are going to change.
timeline.quote: Things are going to change around here.

citation.text: Ascendant Evincar (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax orders the enemy killed and fed to new recruits.
timeline.quote: Kill them all and feed them to the new recruits.

citation.text: Death Pit Offering (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Belbe restores order at the Stronghold and shortlists Crovax, Greven il-Vec and Ertai as evincar, preferring Ertai.
timeline.quote: Ertai made the best impression on her

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax attacks Belbe, who defends herself.
timeline.quote: Crovax attacked her, but Belbe was able to defend herself

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax organizes a coup and Belbe is forced to crown him evincar after a showdown with Ertai and the returning Volrath.
timeline.quote: Crovax organized a coup d'état to force her to declare him evincar

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Dream Halls Belbe learns her origins and reprograms her portal so Eladamri, Takara en-Dal and Lin Sivvi escape to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: she reprogrammed her return portal to Phyrexia to allow Eladamri to escape to Dominaria

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax holds a funeral for Belbe at Volrath's execution, and a twisted four-armed Ertai takes her skull from the pyre.
timeline.quote: a twisted, four-armed Ertai reached into the smoldering pyre and secreted away Belbe's skull

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax executes Volrath, buries Belbe, and has Ertai compleated.
timeline.quote: He also had Ertai compleated into a Phyrexian and made him his court mage.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Rathi Overlay, Crovax oversees Phyrexian domination of Urborg, executes Tsabo Tavoc, and convinces Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: This convinced Gerrard to surrender himself to the Dark Lord.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax leads the counterattack against Multani's Yavimaya, raising the undead.
timeline.quote: He demonstrated his necromantic abilities by raising an army of the undead

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, returned with Yawgmoth's boons, slices Crovax in half; Selenia recovers his normal soul.
timeline.quote: eventually being sliced in half by Gerrard.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexia chose Crovax to take Volrath's place and bestowed new powers on him.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia has chosen Crovax to take Volrath's place

citation.text: "Nemesis", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Weatherlight escapes Rath, Ertai is captured aboard the Predator and Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril shapes him into Volrath's successor.
timeline.quote: Ertai is captured and held aboard the Predator

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax rapidly outpaces rivals in the Evincar succession contest; Greven prefers servitude and Ertai augments himself.
timeline.quote: Ertai proves no match for Crovax's rapid ascent.

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax's assault on Eladamri's Skyshroud elves ends in a rout; he consolidates power by impaling dissenting tribal leaders on flowstone spikes.
timeline.quote: the attack ends in a rout

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The rebel uprising fails; Takara is freed but the rebels are cornered in the Dream Halls.
timeline.quote: The uprising fails, however.

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath returns from Mercadia to challenge Crovax but Ertai sabotages him.
timeline.quote: Volrath, returned from Mercadia

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax becomes undisputed Evincar, Volrath is executed, and Ertai becomes Crovax's mutated servant.
timeline.quote: Crovax stands as the undisputed Evincar of Rath.

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selenia freezes and Crovax's blade kills her, shattering the angel and fulfilling the curse that collapses Crovax's mind.
timeline.quote: As the angel shattered like glass, Crovax felt his mind collapse—the curse had been fulfilled.

citation.text: Death Stroke (Beatdown Box Set, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax, now evincar, takes Gerrard to Phyrexia where Gerrard pledges loyalty to Yawgmoth in hope of Hanna's return.
timeline.quote: where he pledged his loyalty to Yawgmoth, who promised he could bring Hanna back from the dead.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills Crovax in the Stronghold's throne room.
timeline.quote: Gerrard confronted and killed Crovax

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Rathi Overlay begins the second wave, and Tsabo Tavoc is punished and eaten by Crovax.
timeline.quote: ultimately being eaten by Crovax

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Rathi Overlay brings Rath's Phyrexian legions onto Dominaria, and Crovax kills Tsabo Tavoc for failing at Koilos.
timeline.quote: Crovax killed Tsabo Tavoc as punishment for her failure at Koilos

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Stronghold Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Karn takes control of the Predator; Ertai steals Gerrard and Squee to Crovax, who sends Gerrard into Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: In a duel, Tahngarth killed Greven il-Vec and Karn took control of the Predator

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Coalition storms the Stronghold as Gerrard kills Crovax and Squee kills Ertai.
timeline.quote: even as Gerrard killed Crovax and Squee killed Ertai

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Selenia, cursing himself with vampirism.
timeline.quote: Crovax kills Selenia , placing the curse of vampirism on himself.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion (4205 AR to 4206 AR) [ 16 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Mirri on Rath.
timeline.quote: Crovax kills Mirri.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion (4205 AR to 4206 AR) [ 16 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills Crovax.
timeline.quote: Gerrard kills Crovax while Squee kills Ertai.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion (4205 AR to 4206 AR) [ 16 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth launches his full-scale invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth finally launched his full-scale invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sisay crashes the Predator into Crovax's stronghold.
timeline.quote: I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold.

citation.text: Hull Breach (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax tells Ertai he will kill him a hundred times a day as Yawgmoth's reward.
timeline.quote: I shall kill him a hundred times a day.

citation.text: Phyrexian Tyranny (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In an alternate reality seen in Planar Chaos, Mirri strikes the killing blow against Selenia, becomes the vampiric Mirri the Cursed, and is abandoned on Rath.
